name: Cucumber Powdery Mildew
description: A common fungal disease of cucumber that appears as white powdery growth on leaves. It reduces photosynthesis, causes premature defoliation, and reduces fruit quality and yield.
symptoms: White powdery fungal growth on upper leaf surfaces
Yellowing and browning of infected leaves
Stunted vine growth in severe cases
causes: Dense vine canopy with poor air circulation
treatments: Apply sulfur-based fungicides at first signs
Spray neem oil solution (5ml/L water) weekly
Use myclobutanil or trifloxystrobin for severe cases
Apply potassium bicarbonate as organic alternative
prevention: Space plants adequately for air circulation
Avoid overhead irrigation — use drip irrigation
Practice crop rotation with non-cucurbit crops
